description: This PHP class 'TerminationReasonController' manages the termination reason functionalities within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It extends an abstract controller, initializes a service for termination reason configuration, and prepares a Vue component for rendering termination reasons, including setting properties for the frontend.

classes.name: TerminationReasonController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing termination reason features, rendering Vue components, and interacting with termination reason configuration service.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the TerminationReasonConfigurationService instance used for accessing termination reason data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the Vue component with termination reasons before rendering the page.
